resources.title: Motion Tools Pro
resources.description: Advanced motion design toolkit with 50+ presets and controllers for After Effects
resources.longDescription: Motion Tools Pro is a comprehensive toolkit for motion designers working in After Effects. Features include: bezier curve controllers, advanced easing presets, motion path tools, and automated keyframe optimization.
resources.author: Demo Studio

resources.title: Auto Backup Script
resources.description: Automatically save project backups at custom intervals
resources.longDescription: Never lose your work again! This script automatically creates timestamped backups of your After Effects project at intervals you define. Supports network drives and custom naming.
resources.author: DevTools

resources.title: Cinematic Transitions
resources.description: Pack of 120 smooth cinematic transitions for Premiere Pro
resources.longDescription: Professional transition collection featuring smooth cuts, wipes, zooms, and light leaks. All GPU-accelerated for real-time playback. Includes preset browser integration.
resources.author: Cinema Pack

resources.title: Smart Color Match
resources.description: AI-powered color matching and grading assistant
resources.longDescription: Match colors between clips instantly using AI analysis. Creates Lumetri presets from reference images. Batch processing support for consistent color across entire projects.
resources.author: Color Labs

resources.title: Batch Export Pro
resources.description: Export multiple artboards and layers with custom naming conventions
resources.longDescription: Powerful batch export tool for Photoshop. Export artboards, layers, or groups to multiple formats simultaneously. Supports custom naming patterns, resolution multipliers, and folder structure presets.
resources.author: Workflow Tools

resources.title: Text Animation Suite
resources.description: 100+ text animation presets with full customization
resources.longDescription: Complete text animation library for After Effects. Includes kinetic typography, reveal effects, glitch animations, and 3D text presets. All animations are expression-based and fully customizable.
resources.author: Type Motion
